0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Compare decompiled functions with the original machine code.
0003: 
0004: Compiles a decomp source with the original toolchain (GCC 4.4.7-3), then
0005: compares every function symbol of the object with the original function of the
0006: same mangled name. Instructions are normalized: relocated operands and absolute
0007: addresses become symbol names, string literals become their contents, float
0008: constants become their bytes and intra-function branches become instruction
0009: indices. Exact instruction equality is MATCH only when referenced data is
0010: complete and there is no unverified per-function personality/LSDA metadata.
0011: 
0012:     python3 tools/decomp/objdiff.py decomp/src/RunicCore.cpp
0013:     python3 tools/decomp/objdiff.py decomp/src/RunicCore.cpp --show _ZN10CRunicCoreC2Ev
0014:     python3 tools/decomp/objdiff.py --all --json build-decomp/progress.json
0015: """
0016: from __future__ import annotations
0017: 
0018: import argparse
0019: import bisect
0020: import difflib
0021: import hashlib
0022: import json
0023: import os
0024: from pathlib import Path
0025: import re
0026: import subprocess
0027: import sys
0028: import tempfile
0029: import threading

0031: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
0032: import elfdb  # noqa: E402
0033: import elfimage  # noqa: E402
0034: import objdiff_eh  # noqa: E402
0035: import toolchain  # noqa: E402
0036: 
0037: ROOT = elfdb.ROOT
0038: SRC = ROOT / "decomp" / "src"
0039: INSN = re.compile(r"^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(\S+(?: \S+)?)\s*(.*)$")
0040: PREFIXES = ("rep", "repz", "repnz", "lock", "data16", "cs", "ds", "addr32", "rex", "rex.W")
0041: PC_RELATIVE = {2, 4}          # R_X86_64_PC32, R_X86_64_PLT32
0042: ABSOLUTE = {1, 10, 11}        # R_X86_64_64, R_X86_64_32, R_X86_64_32S
0043: PACKED = ("ps", "pd", "dqa", "dqu", "aps", "apd")
0044: 
0045: 
0046: def const_size(mnemonic):
0047:     if mnemonic.startswith("data-size:"):
0048:         return int(mnemonic.split(":")[1])
0049:     integer = re.match(r"^(?:mov|add|sub|and|or|xor|cmp|test|imul|inc|dec|neg|not)([bwlq])$", mnemonic)
0050:     if integer:
0051:         return {"b": 1, "w": 2, "l": 4, "q": 8}[integer.group(1)]
0052:     if mnemonic in ("flds", "fldl", "fldt", "movlps", "movhps", "movlpd", "movhpd"):
0053:         return {"flds": 4, "fldl": 8, "fldt": 10}.get(mnemonic, 8)
0054:     if mnemonic.endswith(PACKED) or mnemonic in ("pxor", "pand", "por", "andps", "xorps"):
0055:         return 16
0056:     if "sd" in mnemonic or mnemonic.endswith("q"):
0057:         return 8
0058:     return 4
0059: 
0060: 
0061: def memory_mnemonic(mnemonic, operands):
0062:     """objdump omits integer width suffixes when the destination determines it."""
0063:     if mnemonic.startswith(("movzb", "movsb")):
0064:         return "data-size:1"
0065:     if mnemonic.startswith(("movzw", "movsw")):
0066:         return "data-size:2"
0067:     if mnemonic.startswith("movsl"):
0068:         return "data-size:4"
0069:     integer = ("mov", "movabs", "add", "sub", "and", "or", "xor", "cmp", "test", "imul")
0070:     if mnemonic in integer:
0071:         register = operands.rsplit(",", 1)[-1].strip()
0072:         if re.fullmatch(r"%(?:r(?:ax|bx|cx|dx|si|di|bp|sp|[0-9]+))", register):
0073:             return "data-size:8"
0074:         if re.fullmatch(r"%(?:[abcd]x|si|di|bp|sp|r[0-9]+w)", register):
0075:             return "data-size:2"
0076:         if re.fullmatch(r"%(?:[abcd][lh]|sil|dil|bpl|spl|r[0-9]+b)", register):
0077:             return "data-size:1"
0078:     return mnemonic
0079: 
0080: 
0081: def printable_string(raw):
0082:     """Literal token for narrow (ASCII) or wide (UTF-32LE wchar_t) strings."""
0083:     wide = []
0084:     for i in range(0, len(raw) - 3, 4):
0085:         code = int.from_bytes(raw[i:i + 4], "little")
0086:         if code == 0:
0087:             break
0088:         if not (32 <= code < 0x10000 or code in (9, 10, 13)):
0089:             wide = None
0090:             break
0091:         wide.append(chr(code))
0092:     else:
0093:         wide = None
0094:     if wide:
0095:         return 'L"' + "".join(wide)
0096:     end = raw.find(b"\0")
0097:     if end <= 0:
0098:         return None
0099:     text = raw[:end]
0100:     if all(32 <= b < 127 or b in (9, 10, 13) for b in text):
0101:         return text.decode("ascii")
0102:     return None
0103: 
0104: 
0105: class UnverifiedData(ValueError):
0106:     pass
0107: 
0108: 
0109: def literal_token(raw, width=None):
0110:     """Full terminated bytes, including character width and payload length.
0111: 
0112:     Linked .rodata has lost string-section width. If both interpretations are
0113:     possible, instruction equality cannot establish the width of the literal.
0114:     """
0115:     def narrow():
0116:         end = raw.find(b"\0")
0117:         if end < 0:
0118:             return None
0119:         if width is None and not all(32 <= b < 127 or b in (9, 10, 13) for b in raw[:end]):
0120:             return None
0121:         return raw[:end]
0122: 
0123:     def wide():
0124:         for end in range(0, len(raw) - 3, 4):
0125:             code = int.from_bytes(raw[end:end + 4], "little")
0126:             if code == 0:
0127:                 return raw[:end]
0128:             if width is None and (code > 0x10ffff or 0xd800 <= code <= 0xdfff
0129:                                   or not (chr(code).isprintable() or code in (9, 10, 13))):
0130:                 return None
0131:         return None
0132: 
0133:     if width not in (None, 1, 4):
0134:         raise UnverifiedData("unsupported string width")
0135:     candidates = [(w, payload) for w, payload in
0136:                   ((1, narrow() if width in (None, 1) else None),
0137:                    (4, wide() if width in (None, 4) else None)) if payload is not None]
0138:     if len(candidates) > 1:
0139:         raise UnverifiedData("ambiguous narrow/wide literal in linked rodata")
0140:     if not candidates:
0141:         raise UnverifiedData("unterminated or unclassified literal")
0142:     w, payload = candidates[0]
0143:     return f"lit:w{w}:n{len(payload) // w}:{payload.hex()}"
0144: 
0145: 
0146: def string_width(section):
0147:     match = re.match(r"^\.rodata\.str([0-9]+)\.", section.name)
0148:     return int(match.group(1)) if match else None
0149: 
0150: 
0151: def run_objdump(args):
0152:     env = dict(os.environ, LC_ALL="C")
0153:     return subprocess.run(["objdump", "-d", "-w", "--no-show-raw-insn"] + args, check=True,
0154:                           capture_output=True, text=True, env=env).stdout
0155: 
0156: 
0157: def parse_insns(text):
0158:     out = []
0159:     for line in text.splitlines():
0160:         m = INSN.match(line)
0161:         if m and not line.lstrip().startswith(("R_X86", "Disassembly")):
0162:             mnemonic, operands = m.group(2), m.group(3).strip()
0163:             # objdump prints prefixes as part of the mnemonic field ("repz ret").
0164:             first = mnemonic.split(" ")
0165:             if len(first) == 2 and first[0] not in PREFIXES:
0166:                 mnemonic, operands = first[0], (first[1] + " " + operands).strip()
0167:             out.append([int(m.group(1), 16), mnemonic, operands])
0168:     return out
0169: 
0170: 
0171: class Normalizer:
0172:     """Shared operand normalization; subclasses resolve addresses to tokens."""
0173: 
0174:     JUMP_TABLE = re.compile(r"^\*(0x[0-9a-f]+)\(,(%\w+),8\)$")
0175: 
0176:     def data_token(self, raw, mnemonic, address_operand=False, width=None):
0177:         try:
0178:             if address_operand:
0179:                 return literal_token(raw, width)
0180:             size = const_size(mnemonic)
0181:             if len(raw) < size:
0182:                 raise UnverifiedData(f"truncated {size}-byte constant")
0183:             return "const:" + raw[:size].hex()
0184:         except UnverifiedData as exc:
0185:             if not hasattr(self, "unverified"):
0186:                 self.unverified = []
0187:             self.unverified.append(str(exc))
0188:             return "unverified-data:" + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
0189: 
0190:     def branch(self, insn_index, target, start, end, offsets):
0191:         if start <= target < end:
0192:             labels = getattr(self, "labels", None)
0193:             if labels and target in labels:
0194:                 return f"L{labels[target]}"
0195:             pos = bisect.bisect_left(offsets, target)
0196:             return f"L{pos}" if pos < len(offsets) and offsets[pos] == target else f"L?{target - start:#x}"
0197:         return None
0198: 
0199:     @staticmethod
0200:     def table_size(k, insns):
0201:         """Entries of a switch table from the bound check (`cmp $N` before the jump)."""
0202:         for _, mnemonic, operands in reversed(insns[max(0, k - 6):k]):
0203:             m = re.match(r"^\$0x([0-9a-f]+),", operands)
0204:             if mnemonic.startswith("cmp") and m:
0205:                 return int(m.group(1), 16) + 1
0206:         return None
0207: 
0208:     def jump_table(self, k, entries, register, start, end, offsets, insns):
0209:         """Token for `jmp *table(,%reg,8)`: the table's targets as instruction labels."""
0210:         count = self.table_size(k, insns)
0211:         labels = []
0212:         for target in entries:
0213:             if count is not None and len(labels) == count:
0214:                 break
0215:             if target is None or not start <= target < end:
0216:                 break
0217:             labels.append(self.branch(k, target, start, end, offsets))
0218:         return f"jmp *[table:{','.join(labels)}](,{register},8)"
0219: 
0220:     @staticmethod
0221:     def padding(mnemonic, operands):
0222:         return (mnemonic in ("nop", "nopw", "nopl", "xchg") and (mnemonic != "xchg" or operands == "%ax,%ax")
0223:                 or mnemonic.startswith(("data16", "cs")))
0224: 
0225:     def normalize(self, insns, start, end):
0226:         self.unverified = []
0227:         offsets = [i[0] for i in insns]
0228:         # Branch labels count kept instructions only: alignment padding differs
0229:         # between the original and our object and must not shift the indices.
0230:         self.labels = {}
0231:         kept = 0
0232:         for address, mnemonic, operands in insns:
0233:             self.labels[address] = kept
0234:             if not self.padding(mnemonic, operands):
0235:                 kept += 1
0236:         result = []
0237:         for k, (address, mnemonic, operands) in enumerate(insns):
0238:             if self.padding(mnemonic, operands):
0239:                 continue
0240:             nxt = offsets[k + 1] if k + 1 < len(offsets) else end
0241:             operands = operands.split("#", 1)[0].strip() if "#" in operands and "(%rip)" in operands else operands
0242:             result.append(self.token(k, address, nxt, mnemonic, operands, start, end, offsets, insns))
0243:         while result and result[-1].split(" ")[0] in ("nop", "xchg"):
0244:             result.pop()
0245:         return result
0246: 
0247: 
0248: class OriginalSide(Normalizer):
0249:     def __init__(self, image, db):
0250:         self.image = image
0251:         self.func_start = {int(a, 16): f["mangled"] for a, f in db["functions"].items()}
0252:         objects = []
0253:         for s in image.symbols:
0254:             if s.type == elfimage.STT_OBJECT and s.defined and s.size and s.name:
0255:                 objects.append((s.value, s.size, s.name))
0256:         for s in image.dynsyms:
0257:             if s.type == elfimage.STT_OBJECT and s.defined and s.size and s.name:
0258:                 objects.append((s.value, s.size, s.name))
0259:         objects.sort()
0260:         self.obj_starts = [o[0] for o in objects]
0261:         self.objects = objects
0262:         # Exact-address names, including zero-sized markers such as __dso_handle.
0263:         self.exact = {}
0264:         for s in list(image.symbols) + list(image.dynsyms):
0265:             if s.defined and s.name and s.type in (elfimage.STT_OBJECT, elfimage.STT_NOTYPE) and s.value:
0266:                 self.exact.setdefault(s.value, s.name.split("@")[0])
0267:         self.rodata = [image.section(n) for n in (".rodata",) if n]
0268:         self.low, self.high = 0x400000, max(s.addr + s.size for s in image.sections if s.addr)
0269: 
0270:     def name_at(self, address, mnemonic, address_operand=False):
0271:         if address in self.func_start:
0272:             return self.func_start[address]
0273:         if address in self.image.plt:
0274:             return self.image.plt[address].split("@")[0]
0275:         i = bisect.bisect_right(self.obj_starts, address) - 1
0276:         if i >= 0:
0277:             start, size, name = self.objects[i]
0278:             name = name.split("@")[0]
0279:             if start <= address < start + size:
0280:                 return name if address == start else f"{name}+{address - start:#x}"
0281:         if address in self.exact:
0282:             return self.exact[address]
0283:         section = self.image.section_at(address)
0284:         if section and section.name.startswith(".rodata"):
0285:             try:
0286:                 available = section.addr + section.size - address
0287:                 raw = self.image.read(address, available if address_operand else min(available, const_size(mnemonic)))
0288:             except ValueError:
0289:                 raw = b""
0290:             return self.data_token(raw, mnemonic, address_operand, string_width(section))
0291:         if section:
0292:             return f"{section.name}:{address:#x}"
0293:         return f"{address:#x}"
0294: 
0295:     def token(self, k, address, nxt, mnemonic, operands, start, end, offsets, insns):
0296:         m = re.match(r"^([0-9a-f]+) <([^>]+)>$", operands)
0297:         if m and (mnemonic.startswith(("j", "call", "loop"))):
0298:             target = int(m.group(1), 16)
0299:             label = self.branch(k, target, start, end, offsets)
0300:             if label:
0301:                 return f"{mnemonic} {label}"
0302:             return f"{mnemonic} {self.name_at(target, mnemonic)}"
0303:         table = self.JUMP_TABLE.match(operands) if mnemonic == "jmp" else None
0304:         if table:
0305:             base = int(table.group(1), 16)
0306: 
0307:             def entries():
0308:                 for i in range(4096):
0309:                     try:
0310:                         yield int.from_bytes(self.image.read(base + 8 * i, 8), "little")
0311:                     except ValueError:
0312:                         return
0313:             return self.jump_table(k, entries(), table.group(2), start, end, offsets, insns)
0314: 
0315:         def rip(mm):
0316:             target = nxt + int(mm.group(1), 16) * (-1 if mm.group(0).startswith("-") else 1)
0317:             return f"[{self.name_at(target, memory_mnemonic(mnemonic, operands), mnemonic.startswith('lea'))}](%rip)"
0318:         operands = re.sub(r"-?0x([0-9a-f]+)\(%rip\)", rip, operands)
0319: 
0320:         def absolute(mm):
0321:             value = int(mm.group(2), 16)
0322:             if self.low <= value < self.high:
0323:                 return f"{mm.group(1)}[{self.name_at(value, memory_mnemonic(mnemonic, operands), mm.group(1) == '$' or mnemonic.startswith('lea'))}]"
0324:             return mm.group(0)
0325:         operands = re.sub(r"(\$|(?<![\w%]))0x([0-9a-f]+)(?=\b)", absolute, operands)
0326:         return f"{mnemonic} {operands}".strip()
0327: 
0328: 
0329: class ObjectSide(Normalizer):
0330:     def __init__(self, obj, resolve=None, name_at=None):
0331:         self.obj = obj
0332:         self.resolve = resolve or (lambda name: None)
0333:         self.name_at = name_at
0334:         self.funcs_by_section = {}
0335:         for s in obj.symbols:
0336:             if s.type == elfimage.STT_FUNC and s.defined:
0337:                 self.funcs_by_section.setdefault(s.shndx, {})[s.value] = s.name
0338:         self.locals_by_section = {}
0339:         for s in obj.symbols:
0340:             if s.type == elfimage.STT_OBJECT and s.defined and s.shndx < len(obj.sections):
0341:                 self.locals_by_section.setdefault(s.shndx, {})[s.value] = s.name
0342: 
0343:     def target_name(self, symbol, offset, mnemonic, address_operand=False):
0344:         obj = self.obj
0345:         if symbol.name and not symbol.name.startswith(".L") and symbol.type != elfimage.STT_SECTION:
0346:             # Same token as the original side: symbol + addend mapped to the original address.
0347:             address = self.resolve(symbol.name)
0348:             if address is not None and self.name_at:
0349:                 return self.name_at(address + offset, mnemonic, address_operand)
0350:         if symbol.defined and symbol.shndx < len(obj.sections) and (
0351:                 symbol.type == elfimage.STT_SECTION or not symbol.name or symbol.name.startswith(".L")):
0352:             offset += symbol.value if symbol.type != elfimage.STT_SECTION else 0
0353:             section = obj.sections[symbol.shndx]
0354:             name = section.name
0355:             if name.startswith(".rodata"):
0356:                 data = obj.section_bytes(symbol.shndx)
0357:                 stop = section.size if address_operand else offset + const_size(mnemonic)
0358:                 raw = data[offset:stop] if 0 <= offset < section.size and len(data) == section.size else b""
0359:                 return self.data_token(raw, mnemonic, address_operand, string_width(section))
0360:             named = self.locals_by_section.get(symbol.shndx, {}).get(offset)
0361:             if named:
0362:                 return named
0363:             func = self.funcs_by_section.get(symbol.shndx, {}).get(offset)
0364:             if func:
0365:                 return func
0366:             return f"{name}+{offset:#x}"
0367:         return symbol.name if offset == 0 else f"{symbol.name}+{offset:#x}"
0368: 
0369:     def prepare(self, section_index):
0370:         self.relocs = sorted(self.obj.relocs.get(section_index, []), key=lambda r: r.offset)
0371:         self.reloc_offsets = [r.offset for r in self.relocs]
0372:         self.section_index = section_index
0373: 
0374:     def token(self, k, address, nxt, mnemonic, operands, start, end, offsets, insns):
0375:         lo = bisect.bisect_left(self.reloc_offsets, address)
0376:         hi = bisect.bisect_left(self.reloc_offsets, nxt)
0377:         relocs = self.relocs[lo:hi]
0378:         table = self.JUMP_TABLE.match(operands) if mnemonic == "jmp" and len(relocs) == 1 else None
0379:         if table and relocs[0].symbol.shndx < len(self.obj.sections):
0380:             symbol = relocs[0].symbol
0381:             base = relocs[0].addend + (symbol.value if symbol.type != elfimage.STT_SECTION else 0)
0382:             rows = {r.offset: r for r in self.obj.relocs.get(symbol.shndx, [])}
0383: 
0384:             def entries():
0385:                 for i in range(4096):
0386:                     r = rows.get(base + 8 * i)
0387:                     if r is None or r.symbol.shndx != self.section_index:
0388:                         return
0389:                     yield r.addend + (r.symbol.value if r.symbol.type != elfimage.STT_SECTION else 0)
0390:             return self.jump_table(k, entries(), table.group(2), start, end, offsets, insns)
0391:         m = re.match(r"^([0-9a-f]+) <([^>]+)>$", operands)
0392:         if m and mnemonic.startswith(("j", "call", "loop")):
0393:             if relocs:
0394:                 r = relocs[0]
0395:                 offset = r.addend + (nxt - r.offset) if r.type in PC_RELATIVE else r.addend
0396:                 if r.symbol.name and r.symbol.name == getattr(self, "current", None) and offset == 0:
0397:                     # Direct recursion: the original side sees a branch to its own entry.
0398:                     return f"{mnemonic} {self.branch(k, start, start, end, offsets)}"
0399:                 return f"{mnemonic} {self.target_name(r.symbol, offset, mnemonic)}"
0400:             target = int(m.group(1), 16)
0401:             label = self.branch(k, target, start, end, offsets)
0402:             if label:
0403:                 return f"{mnemonic} {label}"
0404:             func = self.funcs_by_section.get(self.section_index, {}).get(target)
0405:             return f"{mnemonic} {func or hex(target)}"
0406:         for r in relocs:
0407:             if r.type in PC_RELATIVE:
0408:                 name = self.target_name(r.symbol, r.addend + (nxt - r.offset), memory_mnemonic(mnemonic, operands), mnemonic.startswith("lea"))
0409:                 operands = re.sub(r"-?0x[0-9a-f]+\(%rip\)", lambda _: f"[{name}](%rip)", operands, count=1)
0410:             elif r.type in ABSOLUTE:
0411:                 imm_last = r.offset == nxt - 4 and "$" in operands
0412:                 name = self.target_name(r.symbol, r.addend, memory_mnemonic(mnemonic, operands), imm_last or mnemonic.startswith("lea"))
0413:                 if imm_last:
0414:                     operands = re.sub(r"\$0x[0-9a-f]+", lambda _: f"$[{name}]", operands, count=1)
0415:                 else:
0416:                     operands = re.sub(r"(?<![\w%$])0x[0-9a-f]+(?=\()", lambda _: f"[{name}]", operands, count=1)
0417:         return f"{mnemonic} {operands}".strip()

0419: 
0420: def object_functions(obj_path, resolve=None, name_at=None, globalized=()):
0421:     obj = elfimage.load_object(obj_path)
0422:     frames = objdiff_eh.inspect(obj, relocatable=True)
0423:     text = run_objdump([str(obj_path)])
0424:     sections = {}
0425:     current = None
0426:     for line in text.splitlines():
0427:         m = re.match(r"^Disassembly of section (.+):$", line)
0428:         if m:
0429:             current = m.group(1)
0430:             sections[current] = []
0431:             continue
0432:         if current is not None:
0433:             sections[current].append(line)
0434:     parsed = {name: parse_insns("\n".join(lines)) for name, lines in sections.items()}
0435:     addresses = {name: [i[0] for i in insns] for name, insns in parsed.items()}
0436:     by_name = {s.name: s.index for s in obj.sections}
0437:     side = ObjectSide(obj, resolve, name_at)
0438:     result = {}
0439:     for sym in obj.symbols:
0440:         if sym.type != elfimage.STT_FUNC or not sym.defined:
0441:             continue
0442:         section = obj.sections[sym.shndx]
0443:         positions = addresses.get(section.name, [])
0444:         insns = parsed.get(section.name, [])[bisect.bisect_left(positions, sym.value):
0445:                                             bisect.bisect_left(positions, sym.value + sym.size)]
0446:         side.prepare(by_name[section.name])
0447:         side.current = sym.name
0448:         bind = elfimage.STB_LOCAL if sym.name in globalized else sym.bind
0449:         norm = side.normalize(insns, sym.value, sym.value + sym.size)
0450:         reasons = list(dict.fromkeys(side.unverified))
0451:         eh = frames.reason(sym.value, sym.size, sym.shndx)
0452:         if eh:
0453:             reasons.append(eh)
0454:         result[sym.name] = {"size": sym.size, "bind": bind, "norm": norm,
0455:                             "metadata_reasons": reasons,
0456:                             "personalities": frames.personalities(sym.value, sym.size, sym.shndx)}
0457:     return result
0458: 
0459: 
0460: def image_symbol_names(image):
0461:     """Every symbol name of the original executable, its PLT included."""
0462:     names = {s.name.split("@")[0] for s in list(image.symbols) + list(image.dynsyms) if s.name}
0463:     return names | {n.split("@")[0] for n in image.plt.values()}
0464: 
0465: 
0466: def unknown_members(db, original_names, symbols):
0467:     """Symbols naming a member of a game class the original does not have: a wrong
0468:     signature (constness, reference, parameter type) or an invented method."""
0469:     out = []
0470:     for name in symbols:
0471:         if name in original_names:
0472:             continue
0473:         m = re.match(r"_ZNK?(\d+)", name)
0474:         scope = m and name[m.end():m.end() + int(m.group(1))]
0475:         if scope and scope in db["classes"] and scope not in ("Ogre", "CEGUI", "std", "ParticleUniverse"):
0476:             out.append(name)
0477:     return sorted(set(out))
0478: 
0479: 
0480: def known_overloads(db, mangled):
0481:     """Demangled signatures the original has for the class member `mangled` names."""
0482:     m = re.match(r"_ZNK?(\d+)", mangled)
0483:     scope = mangled[m.end():m.end() + int(m.group(1))]
0484:     rest = mangled[m.end() + int(m.group(1)):]
0485:     n = re.match(r"(\d+)", rest)
0486:     method = rest[n.end():n.end() + int(n.group(1))] if n else None
0487:     return sorted(f["demangled"] for f in db["functions"].values()
0488:                   if f.get("scope") == scope and f.get("method") == method)
0489: 
0490: 
0491: class Original:
0492:     def __init__(self, db=None, elf=None):
0493:         self.db = db or elfdb.load_db()
0494:         self.image = elfimage.load(elf or elfdb.default_elf())
0495:         self.side = OriginalSide(self.image, self.db)
0496:         self.frames = objdiff_eh.inspect(self.image)
0497:         self._lock = threading.RLock()  # the normalizer keeps per-function state
0498:         self.by_name = {}
0499:         for address, f in self.db["functions"].items():
0500:             for name in f["names"]:
0501:                 self.by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(f)
0502: 
0503:     def symbol_names(self):
0504:         with self._lock:
0505:             if not hasattr(self, "_names"):
0506:                 self._names = image_symbol_names(self.image)
0507:             return self._names
0508: 
0509:     def unknown_references(self, obj):
0510:         return unknown_members(self.db, self.symbol_names(),
0511:                                (s.name for s in elfimage.load_object(obj).symbols if not s.defined and s.name))
0512: 
0513:     def known_overloads(self, mangled):
0514:         return known_overloads(self.db, mangled)
0515: 
0516:     def resolver(self, tu):
0517:         data = {}
0518:         for g in self.db["globals"]:
0519:             if g["bind"] != "local":
0520:                 data.setdefault(g["name"], int(g["address"], 16))
0521:         if tu:
0522:             for g in self.db["globals"]:
0523:                 if g["bind"] == "local" and g["file"] == tu["name"]:
0524:                     data[g["name"]] = int(g["address"], 16)
0525:         imports = {n.split("@")[0]: a for a, n in self.image.plt.items()}
0526:         for s in self.image.dynsyms:
0527:             if s.defined and s.value and s.name:
0528:                 imports.setdefault(s.name.split("@")[0], s.value)
0529: 
0530:         def resolve(name):
0531:             if name in data:
0532:                 return data[name]
0533:             f = self.function(name, False, tu)
0534:             if f and any(b != "local" for n, b in zip(f["names"], f["bind"]) if n == name):
0535:                 return int(f["address"], 16)
0536:             f = self.function(name, True, tu)
0537:             if f:
0538:                 return int(f["address"], 16)
0539:             return imports.get(name)
0540:         return resolve
0541: 
0542:     def function(self, name, local=False, tu=None):
0543:         found = self.by_name.get(name) or []
0544:         if local:
0545:             # Local names (__tcf_0, _GLOBAL__I_..., static functions) repeat across TUs.
0546:             found = [f for f in found if tu is not None and f["tu"] == tu["id"]]
0547:         return found[0] if found else None
0548: 
0549:     def normalized(self, f):
0550:         """Normalized original function; cached on disk (the original never changes)."""
0551:         with self._lock:
0552:             cache = self.__dict__.get("_norm_cache")
0553:             if cache is None:
0554:                 cache = self.__dict__["_norm_cache"] = _load_norm_cache()
0555:             key = self.image.sha256 + ":" + f["address"]
0556:             if key not in cache:
0557:                 start = int(f["address"], 16)
0558:                 end = start + f["size"]
0559:                 insns = parse_insns(run_objdump([f"--start-address={start:#x}", f"--stop-address={end:#x}",
0560:                                                  str(self.image.path)]))
0561:                 norm = self.side.normalize(insns, start, end)
0562:                 cache[key] = {"norm": norm, "metadata_reasons": list(dict.fromkeys(self.side.unverified))}
0563:                 _NORM_DIRTY.add(key)
0564:             return cache[key]["norm"]
0565: 
0566:     def metadata_reasons(self, f):
0567:         with self._lock:
0568:             self.normalized(f)
0569:             reasons = list(self._norm_cache[self.image.sha256 + ":" + f["address"]]["metadata_reasons"])
0570:             reason = self.frames.reason(int(f["address"], 16), f["size"])
0571:             if reason:
0572:                 reasons.append(reason)
0573:             return reasons
0574: 
0575: 
0576: NORM_CACHE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "build-decomp" / "db" / "orig-normalized.pickle"
0577: _NORM_DIRTY = set()
0578: NORMALIZER_VERSION = 2
0579: 
0580: 
0581: def _norm_key():
0582:     # Normalization depends on this file, the database and the ELF image reader.
0583:     here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
0584:     return [NORMALIZER_VERSION] + [hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
0585:                                    for p in (here / "objdiff.py", here / "elfimage.py", here / "objdiff_eh.py",
0586:                                              NORM_CACHE.parent / "elfdb.json") if p.exists()]
0587: 
0588: 
0589: def _load_norm_cache():
0590:     import pickle
0591:     try:
0592:         data = pickle.loads(NORM_CACHE.read_bytes())
0593:         if data.get("key") == _norm_key():
0594:             return data["functions"]
0595:     except (OSError, ValueError, EOFError, pickle.UnpicklingError, AttributeError):
0596:         pass
0597:     return {}
0598: 
0599: 
0600: def save_norm_cache(original):
0601:     import pickle
0602:     cache = original.__dict__.get("_norm_cache")
0603:     if cache and _NORM_DIRTY:
0604:         NORM_CACHE.write_bytes(pickle.dumps({"key": _norm_key(), "functions": cache}))
0605:         _NORM_DIRTY.clear()
0606: 
0607: 
0608: def tu_for_source(db, source):
0609:     name = Path(source).name
0610:     matches = [t for t in db["tus"] if t["name"].lower() == name.lower()]
0611:     return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
0612: 
0613: 
0614: def globalize_locals(text):
0615:     """Make file-local symbols global so relocations keep symbol+addend (codegen unchanged)."""
0616:     names = set()
0617:     out = []
0618:     declared = set(re.findall(r"^\s*\.(?:globl|weak)\s+(\S+)", text, re.M))
0619:     for line in text.splitlines():
0620:         m = re.match(r"^\s*\.local\s+(\S+)\s*$", line)
0621:         if m:
0622:             names.add(m.group(1))
0623:             out.append(f"\t.globl\t{m.group(1)}")
0624:             continue
0625:         m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_][\w.$]*):\s*$", line)
0626:         if m and m.group(1) not in declared:
0627:             names.add(m.group(1))
0628:             out.append(f"\t.globl\t{m.group(1)}")
0629:         out.append(line)
0630:     return "\n".join(out) + "\n", names
0631: 
0632: 
0633: def compile_for_diff(source, tmp, extra=(), quiet=False):
0634:     asm = toolchain.compile_source(source, Path(tmp) / "unit.s", extra, assembly=True, quiet=quiet)
0635:     text, globalized = globalize_locals(Path(asm).read_text())
0636:     patched = Path(tmp) / "unit.global.s"
0637:     patched.write_text(text)
0638:     return toolchain.assemble(patched, Path(tmp) / "unit.o"), globalized
0639: 
0640: 
0641: def code_digest(norm):
0642:     """Progress fingerprint of normalized instructions, not full object identity.
0643: 
0644:     Acceptance evidence must use object_digest, which includes data, EH and
0645:     relocations as well as code.
0646:     """
0647:     return hashlib.sha256("\n".join(norm).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
0648: 
0649: 
0650: def compare_source(source, original, show=None, extra=(), quiet=False):
0651:     """quiet: compiler errors go into the SystemExit message instead of stderr."""
0652:     tu = tu_for_source(original.db, source)
0653:     with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="otl-diff-") as tmp:
0654:         obj, globalized = compile_for_diff(source, tmp, extra, quiet)
0655:         object_digest = hashlib.sha256(Path(obj).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
0656:         ours = object_functions(obj, original.resolver(tu), original.side.name_at, globalized)
0657:         unknown = original.unknown_references(obj)
0658:     rows = []
0659:     seen = set()
0660:     for name, mine in sorted(ours.items()):
0661:         f = original.function(name, mine["bind"] == elfimage.STB_LOCAL, tu)
0662:         if not f:
0663:             rows.append({"name": name, "status": "EXTRA", "size": mine["size"],
0664:                          "object_digest": object_digest})
0665:             continue
0666:         theirs = original.normalized(f)
0667:         metadata_reasons = list(dict.fromkeys(mine["metadata_reasons"] + original.metadata_reasons(f)))
0668:         if mine["personalities"] != original.frames.personalities(int(f["address"], 16), f["size"]):
0669:             metadata_reasons.append("EH personality differs")
0670:         seen.add(f["address"])
0671:         if mine["norm"] == theirs and not metadata_reasons:
0672:             status, score = "MATCH", 1.0
0673:         else:
0674:             score = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, mine["norm"], theirs, autojunk=False).ratio()
0675:             status = "DIFF"
0676:         row = {"name": name, "demangled": f["demangled"], "address": f["address"], "status": status,
0677:                "score": round(score, 4), "size": mine["size"], "original_size": f["size"],
0678:                "weak": mine["bind"] == elfimage.STB_WEAK, "code": code_digest(mine["norm"]),
0679:                "object_digest": object_digest}
0680:         if metadata_reasons:
0681:             row["metadata_reasons"] = metadata_reasons
0682:         rows.append(row)
0683:         if show and (show == "all" or show in (name, f["demangled"])):
0684:             print(f"--- ours {name}\n+++ original {f['address']} {f['demangled']}")
0685:             for line in difflib.unified_diff(mine["norm"], theirs, lineterm="", n=1000):
0686:                 if not line.startswith(("---", "+++")):
0687:                     print(line)
0688:     if tu:
0689:         for address, f in original.db["functions"].items():
0690:             if f["tu"] == tu["id"] and address not in seen and f["kind"] not in ("compiler", "inline_or_template"):
0691:                 rows.append({"name": f["mangled"], "demangled": f["demangled"], "address": address,
0692:                              "status": "MISSING", "original_size": f["size"], "object_digest": object_digest})
0693:     return {"source": str(Path(source).resolve().relative_to(ROOT)) if Path(source).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(source),
0694:             "tu": tu["name"] if tu else None, "functions": rows,
0695:             "object_digest": object_digest,
0696:             "unknown": [{"name": n, "known": original.known_overloads(n)} for n in unknown]}
0697: 
0698: 
0699: def report(result):
0700:     print(f"{result['source']}  (original TU: {result['tu'] or '?'})")
0701:     for row in result["functions"]:
0702:         label = row.get("demangled") or row["name"]
0703:         score = f"{row['score'] * 100:5.1f}%" if "score" in row else "     "
0704:         weak = " (inline)" if row.get("weak") else ""
0705:         print(f"  {row['status']:7} {score} {row.get('address', ''):>9} {label}{weak}")
0706:         for reason in row.get("metadata_reasons", []):
0707:             print(f"          {reason}")
0708:     counts = {}
0709:     for row in result["functions"]:
0710:         counts[row["status"]] = counts.get(row["status"], 0) + 1
0711:     for ref in result.get("unknown", []):
0712:         print(f"  UNKNOWN {ref['name']}: not in the original; it has: {'; '.join(ref['known']) or 'no such member'}")
0713:     print("  " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in sorted(counts.items())))
0714: 
0715: 
0716: def main():
0717:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0718:     parser.add_argument("sources", nargs="*", type=Path)
0719:     parser.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="every decomp/src/**/*.cpp")
0720:     parser.add_argument("--show", help="mangled/demangled name or 'all': print normalized diff")
0721:     parser.add_argument("--json", type=Path)
0722:     parser.add_argument("--elf", type=Path, default=None)
0723:     args = parser.parse_args()
0724:     sources = list(args.sources)
0725:     if args.all:
0726:         sources += sorted(SRC.rglob("*.cpp"))
0727:     if not sources:
0728:         parser.error("no sources")
0729:     original = Original(elf=args.elf)
0730:     results = [compare_source(s, original, args.show) for s in sources]
0731:     save_norm_cache(original)
0732:     for r in results:
0733:         report(r)
0734:     if args.json:
0735:         args.json.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0736:         args.json.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": 1, "elf": original.image.sha256, "units": results}, indent=1))
0737:     bad = sum(1 for r in results for f in r["functions"] if f["status"] == "DIFF")
0738:     return 1 if bad and not args.show else 0
0739: 
0740: 
0741: if __name__ == "__main__":
0742:     sys.exit(main())
